verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is that Web File lets users schedule payments in advance. That is a one-off, future-dated payment, not a recurring schedule, and nothing shows users can define recurring jobs or workflows. The probes also found no API or OpenAPI surface through which an AI-native user could automate such workflows, so this is at most an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: With Web File, you can schedule payments in advance
